page.notes: Hebrew words are printed inside boxes in the scan; the first and second "שבעים" differ in vowel pointing and are transcribed as shown. "dua" is partly covered by an ink spot, so the letter after it is doubtful. The "בור" after "de" is not fully clear. Catchword "runt" and signature "Aa 5" are read from the foot of the page and the signature is doubtful. Spelling "qvod", "aliqvi", "loqvi" are printed with v, kept as printed in the Latin where the u/v rule applies to consonants; "loquere" and "loqui" were copied as printed.
